condition: Selecting a list of labels on an inner MultiIndex level with .loc[:, [labels]] gives rows in an order that depends on the index's lexsort depth and the order of the labels: sometimes grouped by outer level, sometimes by the order of the labels.
workaround: Don't rely on the result's row order. Call sort_index() on the result, or select with a boolean mask (e.g. index.isin(labels, level=1)) to keep the original order.
